```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(haven, openxlsx2, gtsummary, gt, labelled, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This document generates a supplementary table with comprehensive baseline clinical and demographic characteristics stratified by dementia transition category.

## Introduction

This document creates an Excel file containing baseline characteristics of the AGES cohort stratified by dementia transition categories. The format follows the proteomics Nature Aging 2024 supplementary tables.

## Load Data

### Derived Variables

Load the AGES1 derived variables from the SAS dataset.

```{r}
#| label: load-derived-variables

dv <- haven::read_sas(here("data/private/ages1_derived_variables_nov2021.sas7bdat")) |>
  clean_names()

dim(dv)
```

### APOE Genotype

Load the APOE genotype data.

```{r}
#| label: load-apoe

apoe <- haven::read_sas(here("data/private/apoe_genotype.sas7bdat")) |>
  clean_names() |>
  select(subr_id18, genoapoe) |>
  mutate(subr_id18 = as.character(subr_id18))

glimpse(apoe)
```

### Dementia Status

Load the dementia status from the methylation dataset.

```{r}
#| label: load-dementia-status

dem <- read_rds(here("data/collaborator_only/covariates_and_meth_DMP_on_chr21.rds")) |>
  # Exclude subjects with missing smoking status (n=5)
  filter(!is.na(a1smokingstatus)) |>
  select(subr_id18, dementia_ages1_eos) |>
  mutate(subr_id18 = as.character(subr_id18))

glimpse(dem)
```

## Merge Data

### Select Target Variables

```{r}
#| label: select-target-vars

target_vars <- c("a1education", "a1bmi", "a1memory2", "a1speed2", "a1working2",
                 "a1sys", "a1did", "a1s_chol", "a1s_tg", "a1s_glu")
```

### Merge Datasets

```{r}
#| label: merge-data

baseline_data <- dv |>
  select(subr_id18, all_of(target_vars)) |>
  mutate(subr_id18 = as.character(subr_id18)) |>
  inner_join(dem, by = "subr_id18") |>
  inner_join(apoe, by = "subr_id18") 

dim(baseline_data)
glimpse(baseline_data)
```

## Clean and Label Variables

```{r}
#| label: clean-and-label

baseline_clean <- baseline_data |>
  # Reorder the columns
  relocate(subr_id18, a1education, a1bmi, a1sys, a1did, a1s_chol, a1s_tg, a1s_glu, a1memory2, a1speed2, a1working2, genoapoe) |>
  # Recode dementia transition for display
  mutate(
    dementia_transition = fct_relevel(
      dementia_ages1_eos,
      "stable_normal", "normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev"
    ),
    # Recode APOE genotype as factor with Greek epsilon labels
    genoapoe = factor(genoapoe, levels = c("22", "23", "33", "24", "34", "44")) |>
      fct_recode(
        "ε2/ε2" = "22",
        "ε2/ε3" = "23",
        "ε3/ε3" = "33",
        "ε2/ε4" = "24",
        "ε3/ε4" = "34",
        "ε4/ε4" = "44"
      ),
    # Recode education as categorical variable
    # Primary (≤6 years), Secondary (≤9 years), College (~13 years), University (≥14 years)
    education = case_when(
      a1education == 1 ~ "Primary",
      a1education == 2 ~ "Secondary",
      a1education == 3 ~ "College",
      a1education == 4 ~ "University",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Primary", "Secondary", "College", "University"))
  ) |>
  select(-dementia_ages1_eos, -a1education) |>
  # Move education to first position after subr_id18

  relocate(education, .after = subr_id18) |>
  # Set variable labels
  labelled::set_variable_labels(
    education = "Education",
    a1bmi = "BMI (kg/m2)",
    a1sys = "Systolic BP (mmHg)",
    a1did = "Diastolic BP (mmHg)",
    a1s_chol = "Serum cholesterol (mmol/L)",
    a1s_tg = "Serum triglycerides (mmol/L)",
    a1s_glu = "Fasting glucose (mmol/L)",
    # a1s_hba1 = "HbA1c",
    a1memory2 = "Memory score",
    a1speed2 = "Processing speed score",
    a1working2 = "Working memory score",
    # a1dm = "Diabetes mellitus",
    genoapoe = "APOE genotype",
    dementia_transition = "Dementia transition"
  )

glimpse(baseline_clean)
```

## Create Summary Table

### Generate Table with gtsummary

```{r}
#| label: create-summary-table

tbl <- baseline_clean |>
  select(-subr_id18) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = dementia_transition,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing"
  ) |>
  add_p(
    test = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "kruskal.test",
      all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test"
    )
  ) |>
  add_overall(last = FALSE) |>
  bold_labels()

tbl
```

### Save the table as PNG file

```{r}
tbl |> 
  as_gt() |> 
  gtsave(file = here("demographics/output/baseline_characteristics_by_dementia.png"), expand = 10, vwidth = 1200, vheight = 1600, zoom = 2)
```

### Save the table without APOE as PNG file

```{r}
baseline_clean |>
  select(-subr_id18, -genoapoe) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = dementia_transition,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "no"
  ) |>
  add_p(
    test = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "kruskal.test",
      all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test"
    )
  ) |>
  add_overall(last = FALSE) |>
  bold_labels() |>
  as_gt() |>
  gtsave(file = here("demographics/output/baseline_characteristics_by_dementia_no_apoe.png"), expand = 10, vwidth = 1200, vheight = 1400, zoom = 2)
```

### Convert to Data Frame for Excel

```{r}
#| label: convert-to-df

tbl_df <- tbl |>
  as_tibble()

glimpse(tbl_df)
```

## Export to Excel

### Create Workbook

```{r}
#| label: create-workbook

# Create workbook
wb <- wb_workbook() |>
  wb_set_bookview(window_height = 100000, window_width = 100000)

# Define legend
legend <- "Supplementary Table X. Baseline characteristics of the AGES cohort stratified by dementia transition. Continuous variables are presented as mean (SD). Categorical variables are presented as n (%). P values are obtained from Kruskal-Wallis test for continuous variables and chi-square test for categorical variables. Education levels: Primary (6 years or less); Secondary (9 years or less); College (around 13 years); University (14 years or more). Dementia transitions: stable_normal = cognitively normal at baseline and follow-up (reference); normal2mci = normal to MCI; stable_mci = MCI at baseline and follow-up; normal2incid = normal to incident dementia; mci2incid = MCI to incident dementia; prev = prevalent dementia at blood draw."

# Sheet name
sheet_name <- "Baseline_characteristics"
```

### Add Data to Worksheet

```{r}
#| label: add-data-to-worksheet

# Add worksheet
wb <- wb |>
  wb_add_worksheet(sheet_name)

# Add legend (row 1)
wb <- wb |>
  wb_add_data(sheet = sheet_name, x = legend, start_row = 1, start_col = 1)

# Merge legend cells
n_cols <- ncol(tbl_df)
wb <- wb |>
  wb_merge_cells(sheet = sheet_name, rows = 1, cols = 1:n_cols)

# Add data (starting row 3)
wb <- wb |>
  wb_add_data(sheet = sheet_name, x = tbl_df, start_row = 3, start_col = 1)
```

### Apply Formatting

```{r}
#| label: apply-formatting

# Define styles
legend_style <- wb_add_font(wb, bold = TRUE, size = 11)
header_style <- wb_add_font(wb, bold = TRUE, size = 10)

# Get data dimensions
n_rows <- nrow(tbl_df)
data_start_row <- 3
data_end_row <- data_start_row + n_rows

# Format legend row
wb <- wb |>
  wb_add_cell_style(
    sheet = sheet_name,
    dims = wb_dims(rows = 1, cols = 1),
    wrap_text = TRUE,
    vertical = "top"
  ) |>
  wb_set_row_heights(sheet = sheet_name, rows = 1, heights = 80)

# Format header row
wb <- wb |>
  wb_add_font(
    sheet = sheet_name,
    dims = wb_dims(rows = data_start_row, cols = 1:n_cols),
    bold = TRUE
  ) |>
  wb_add_cell_style(
    sheet = sheet_name,
    dims = wb_dims(rows = data_start_row, cols = 1:n_cols),
    wrap_text = TRUE
  )

# Add borders to data area
wb <- wb |>
  wb_add_border(
    sheet = sheet_name,
    dims = wb_dims(rows = data_start_row:data_end_row, cols = 1:n_cols),
    left_border = "thin",
    right_border = "thin",
    top_border = "thin",
    bottom_border = "thin"
  )

# Set column widths
wb <- wb |>
  wb_set_col_widths(
    sheet = sheet_name,
    cols = 1,
    widths = 25
  ) |>
  wb_set_col_widths(
    sheet = sheet_name,
    cols = 2:n_cols,
    widths = 15
  )

# Add alternating row colors for data rows
light_gray <- wb_color(hex = "F2F2F2")
for (i in seq(data_start_row + 1, data_end_row, by = 2)) {
  wb <- wb |>
    wb_add_fill(
      sheet = sheet_name,
      dims = wb_dims(rows = i, cols = 1:n_cols),
      color = light_gray
    )
}
```

### Save Workbook

```{r}
#| label: save-workbook

# Create output directory
fs::dir_create(here("demographics/output"))

# Save workbook
output_file <- here("demographics/output/baseline_characteristics_by_dementia.xlsx")
wb |> wb_save(output_file)

glue("Excel file saved to: {output_file}")
```

## Summary

This document created an Excel file containing baseline characteristics stratified by dementia transition categories:

- **Variables included**: Education, BMI, cognitive scores (memory, speed, working memory), systolic BP, diabetes indicators, serum measures (cholesterol, triglycerides, glucose, HbA1c), and APOE genotype
- **Stratification**: 6 dementia transition categories plus overall
- **Statistics**: Mean (SD) for continuous, n (%) for categorical, with p-values from Kruskal-Wallis and chi-square tests
